Frequently asked questions

What are store hours & location

SunnyDayz is open 7-days a week from 10:00am to 9:00am. Store hours may vary during certain Holidays.

SunnyDayz is located at 105 Greenfield Road, South Deerfield, MA, directly on Routes 5 & 10 and just minutes from I-91.

Where can I find SunnyDayz's latest menu & product availabiltiy

Our online menu is updated regularly to reflect our latest products and availability. Visit the Shop section of our website to browse what’s currently available, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vapes, edibles, beverages, and more.

Want to stay ahead of the latest drops? Join Sun Club for exclusive offers, SunnyDayz news, new product drops, and other member perks.

Product availability can change throughout the day, so check our online menu for the most up-to-date selection.

What forms of identification does SunnyDayz accept

SunnyDayz accepts Valid state-issued driver’s license, U.S. passport/passport card, military ID, permanent resident card, or foreign passport.

SunnyDayz does not accept the following forms of Identification: Expired Drivers License, photocopies or photos of Driver’s License, temporary paper licenses without required supporting documentation, student IDs, employer IDs, library cards, or similar IDs.

Have a business inquiry or question

For general business inquiries, partnerships, wholesale opportunities, vendor questions, or other requests, we’d love to hear from you.

Please contact us at info@sunnydayzcannabis.com, and a member of the SunnyDayz team will get back to you as soon as possible.
